Placeholder for binary attachments
===================================

This corpus intentionally ships only tiny text-based attachments (.txt, .csv, .md)
that Phase 3 can parse without external binary libraries.

The attachment manifests reference these binary formats as placeholders so the
ingestion pipeline can be tested for "attachment present, parser required" cases
without committing real binaries:

  - application/pdf  (architecture-diagram.pdf)   -> Phase 3 PDF text extraction
  - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet (capacity-plan.xlsx) -> Phase 3 XLSX parsing

Phase 3 parser targets to implement/verify:
  txt   -> plain read (covered by real fixture)
  csv   -> tabular parse (covered by real fixture)
  md    -> markdown parse (covered by real fixture)
  pdf   -> text extraction (placeholder only)
  docx  -> document parse (placeholder only)
  xlsx  -> spreadsheet parse (placeholder only)
